geometry: Preserve the exact square canvas, flat-top hex footprint, camera, scale, deep tapered island, centered recessed front stairs, and transparent padding.
Keep one small circular standing patch in the lower third, horizontally centered immediately above the front stairs.
The standing patch is only large enough for Steppling, connects to the stairs with at most one broad stepping stone, and remains at the same anchor in every stage.
Keep the middle readable while allowing the trailhead environment to develop naturally around the lower standing patch.
style: Premium cozy stylized 3D toy diorama matching the approved Steppling runtime tile.
Chunky rounded clay-like forms, broad soft bevels, matte simplified materials, low-frequency surfaces, warm diffuse light, and clean silhouettes.
Use Steppling's established sky-blue, muted slate, warm ochre, sandstone, timber, and orange-accent palette.
Every important feature must remain readable at 256 pixels.
persistentLandmarks: The small rear-center trail marker develops into the signature explorer lookout without changing its anchor position.
The upper-left resting point develops into a bench and water station and remains upper-left.
The upper-right route marker develops into the map and gear point and remains upper-right.
The small lower-center character standing patch remains open at every stage.
exclude: standing patch in the vertical center

stages.name: Forgotten Trailhead
stages.narrative: Steppling has found the beginning of a path, but nowhere yet to pause or plan.
stages.floor: Broad bare compacted trail earth covers most of the floor in warm muted ochre, with two or three large faded slate patches and no repeated texture.
stages.landmark: One short weathered blank waypoint post at rear-center.
props: one rolled blanket near the upper-right wall
two large rounded stones near the upper-left wall
stages.density: Very sparse, exposed, and visibly incomplete.

stages.name: First Waypoint
stages.narrative: The first useful marker makes stepping outside feel possible.
stages.floor: Warm compacted trail earth remains dominant while a few broad smooth slate stepping areas establish the first usable route.
stages.landmark: The same rear-center waypoint is repaired and gains one simple orange direction marker with no writing.
props: one chunky rest stool at upper-left
one neatly rolled trail blanket at upper-right
stages.lighting: Clear friendly daylight with one restrained amber marker glow.
stages.density: A modest first stopping place with large useful shapes.

stages.name: Trail Rest
stages.narrative: Steppling creates a dependable place to prepare, rest, and choose the next route.
stages.floor: The compacted ochre floor is established with a few broad slate rest areas and an uncluttered middle.
stages.landmark: The rear-center waypoint becomes a compact open timber trail shelter with a rounded muted-blue canopy.
props: one chunky bench and broad water station at upper-left
one blank map board and simple gear stand at upper-right
two rounded pine forms along the rear wall
stages.lighting: Soft sunny trail daylight with one warm shelter lantern.
stages.density: Clearly established and useful without hiking clutter.

stages.name: Pathfinder Basecamp
stages.narrative: The trailhead becomes a welcoming base for familiar routes and curious detours.
stages.floor: Smooth ochre and slate floor masses create a rich trailhead composition while the small lower standing patch stays clear.
stages.landmark: The same rear-center shelter grows into a compact hiking lodge with a broad blue roof, glowing doorway, and low lookout deck.
props: the established upper-left bench and water station
the upper-right blank map and gear point
stages.lighting: Bright highland daylight with restrained warm lodge and lantern light.
stages.density: Rich, welcoming, and clearly developed using only broad readable forms.

stages.name: Grand Explorer's Lookout
stages.narrative: Steppling's path opens into a definitive home for movement, perspective, and every journey still ahead.
stages.floor: A polished but low-detail highland trailhead of broad warm ochre and slate masses surrounds the small lower standing patch.
stages.landmark: The same rear-center lodge culminates in a signature rounded explorer lookout with an elevated blue-roofed viewing deck, warm glowing doorway, and one large simple orange waypoint emblem without text.
props: the resolved upper-left rest and water nook
the resolved upper-right map and gear point
four large rounded pine masses framing the lookout
one simple oversized telescope on the rear deck
stages.lighting: Clear golden highland daylight with restrained amber landmark glow.
stages.density: Definitive signature destination with a strong silhouette and no micro-detail.
